axis: Replace milestones with bet structures (leading + lagging + kill criteria + compounding loop). 10-year arc, not 24-month roadmap.

questions.question: Are phases dated to months or quarters (not vague)?
Are leading indicators (weekly/monthly observable) explicitly named per phase?
Do kill criteria specify both date AND quantitative threshold?

questions.pattern: (compounding|network effect|each new.+improves|fleet learning|knowledge graph compounds|knowledge engine grows|moat tightens)
questions.question: Is at least one compounding loop (gets stronger without new input) named?
Does the doc commit to a multi-year arc (Y1/Y2/Y3 or longer) with concrete revenue/state per year?
Is the closing-window (CMMC deadline, competitor catch-up) dated to a specific year?

patterns: \b(in the future|down the road|long[- ]term horizon|over time|some day|eventually)\b
questions.question: Zero vague phrases like 'long-term', 'down the road', 'in the future' without specific dates?
Is there an explicit phase-review or go/no-go decision gate?

questions.pattern: (24-month window|window closes|moat erodes|window of opportunity|first-mover.+months|6 months ahead|24 months ahead)
questions.question: Is the competitive timing clock (when does the window close?) explicitly stated?
